questions.q: Which database should the project use?

dialogsShown.title: Grok asks (1/1): Which database should the project use?
options: Postgres — A client-server database for concurrent access, stronger constraints, and multi-user deployments.
SQLite — A single-file embedded database with no separate server, suited to local and single-process apps.

ask.answerText: I'll ask which database you want, then reply with your choice.chosen=SQLite
